description: This file is a shell script for testing certain git repository information functionalities. It contains test descriptions, setup commands, and assertions to verify the correct retrieval of repository info such as layout, object format, and other keys.

methods.name: test_repo_info
methods.description: Function to test retrieval of specific repository info keys and their expected values.

calls: test_expect_success 'git-repo-info fails if an invalid key is requested'
test_expect_success 'git-repo-info outputs data even if there is an invalid field'
test_expect_success 'git-repo-info aborts when requesting an invalid format'
test_expect_success 'git repo info uses the last requested format'
test_expect_success 'git repo info --all returns all key-value pairs'
